sourceOfTruth.rule: Private VMesh is canonical. Public-safe discovery outputs may be ingested into private; private source truth is never pushed outward by default.

operatingRules: VMesh is an aggregator and indexer, not heavy data storage.
Terrain selection runs first; vectors, soils, landcover, ecology, climate, hazard, imagery, and parcel context cannot upgrade terrain truth.
Return source refs, coverage evidence, fetch recipes, confidence, rejected-source reasons, and gaps.
Downstream workers execute recipes and store or render payloads.
Synthetic, generic, visual, or modelled fallbacks must be explicitly labelled and confidence-capped.
Do not commit exact private coordinates, private addresses, local paths, secrets, signed URLs, paid-provider refs, or raw bulky payloads.
License-gated or research-only sources stay out of operational defaults until reviewed.

landIntelligenceAggregator: For USA, Canada, and UK samples, VMesh can select terrain, vectors, hydro, soils, landcover, ecology, climate/weather, risk/hazard, imagery, and parcel/planning source candidates.
Each selected source includes role, coverage status, resolution or scale where known, confidence, license, attribution, limitations, rejected alternatives, and gaps.
VMesh emits executable recipes without storing heavy payloads by default.
Coverage gaps fail closed as needs_probe, blocked, license_gated, or source-ref-only.
abundanceSeam: VMesh emits vmesh-abundance-source-handoff-v1 for each public-safe matrix sample.
Abundance consumes the handoff and writes normalized builder inputs.
Abundance source-pack summaries are emitted with ready layers or explicit blocked gaps.
A runtime-pack readiness/input artifact exists for every sample without changing the frozen site-runtime-pack.v1 contract.
globalAnyCoordinateSourceClosure: Every valid Earth coordinate returns executable terrain, ecology/landcover, and building source plans or an explicit non-applicable/no-coverage result.
Regional authoritative and high-resolution sources outrank global fallbacks only when coverage and downstream execution are proven.
Global terrain fallback, global ecological context, and global building queries remain source-honest and never fabricate missing features or attributes.
Operational sources pass the executable promotion gate; metadata-only intelligence remains operator-visible but cannot be selected for the game.
VMesh emits a privacy-safe vmesh-abundance-source-handoff-v1 plan without storing heavy provider payloads.
